title: Tire Bay Fitment Limits for Northgate Tire Center Packages
content:
# Northgate Tire Center — Fitment Limits by Package

Every Northgate Tire Center installation package is sold for one vehicle class, up to a highest gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR), and up to a largest wheel diameter the Tire Center mounts under that package. Each package is sold for tires bought on a Northgate purchase.

| Package | Vehicle class | Highest GVWR covered (pounds) | Largest wheel diameter mounted (inches) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | passenger | 6000 | 22 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | passenger | 6000 | 22 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | light truck | 10000 | 20 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | passenger | 6000 | 22 |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | passenger | 6000 | 24 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | light truck | 10000 | 20 |

## How the limits read

- **Vehicle class.** Four packages are sold for passenger vehicles; the two light truck packages are sold for light trucks.
- **GVWR.** The figure is the highest rating the package covers, so a vehicle rated exactly at the figure is within it: a passenger vehicle rated at 6000 pounds is within a passenger package's limit, and one rated at 6001 pounds is not.
- **Wheel diameter.** The figure is the largest wheel the Tire Center mounts under the package: a 22-inch wheel is within the limit of the Northgate Tire Installation Package, a 24-inch wheel is within the limit of Northgate Premium Tire Care only, and a 21-inch wheel is beyond the 20-inch limit of both light truck packages.

## Hypothetical comparisons

| Hypothetical vehicle | Packages whose class, GVWR and wheel limits it meets |
|---|---|
| Passenger car, GVWR 4200 pounds, 18-inch wheels | the four passenger packages |
| Passenger SUV, GVWR 5900 pounds, 23-inch wheels | Northgate Premium Tire Care only |
| Light truck, GVWR 9800 pounds, 18-inch wheels | the two light truck packages |
| Light truck, GVWR 10500 pounds, 18-inch wheels | none |
